svg.text: L3 Lab — Multi-Area OSPF Enterprise Network
As-built: Office (Area 1) and the Area 0 path to the DHCP server are live; Warehouse (Area 2), ABR2, ASBR2 and the redundant backbone are cabled but unconfigured.
All facts read from the device configs in the export. Cabling/interfaces from the links list; addressing, areas, VLANs, DHCP and interface state from each running-config.
